name: Lucas Lynggaard Tønnesen
bio:
Lucas Lynggaard Tønnesen is a Danish actor. He is best known for his roles in the Netflix series The Rain and Borgen – Power & Glory. In 2022, he starred in the Netflix multilingual mystery-science fiction series 1899.
